ads.headline: 🔥 THE ARENA OF FIRE IRELAND TOUR 🔥
ads.primaryText:
🔥 THE ARENA OF FIRE IRELAND TOUR 🔥 This October we ignite the flames of legendary Rock & Metal anthems in an explosive 120-minute concert. Experience the beauty of classical alongside the power of pyro. 

From haunting symphonic passages to full-throttle rock explosions, Arena of Fire moves between the sublime and the ferocious - an unforgettable night of spectacle and sound.

Performing the music of: Metallica • AC/DC • The Rolling Stones • My Chemical Romance • Linkin Park • System Of A Down • Guns N' Roses • Evanescence • Papa Roach • The Cranberries & MORE
